new_findings.title: Live frontend health runs before Caddy receives the app volume
new_findings.defect: --apply reloads the portal Caddyfile and requires APP_HEALTH_CMD to verify the live frontend before reporting success, but the compose overlay that mounts APP_WWW at /srv/app-portal is only applied after successful apply in the runbook. On a fresh host without that mount, the new Caddy root has no frontend files and the live health check fails, causing rollback before the documented compose step can be reached.
new_findings.failure_scenario: On a fresh deployment, follow the runbook apply command while Caddy has no /srv/app-portal volume; APP_HEALTH_CMD gets a failing response for https://app.altcontext.com/, run_health fails, and activation_fail restores the old Caddyfile. The next documented step to apply docker-compose.app.yml is only reached after success.
new_findings.fix: Apply the rendered compose overlay and ensure Caddy mounts APP_WWW before the live frontend health check, or make the deploy explicitly stage/apply that integration before health; update the runbook order to match.

summary: All ten recorded corrections hold with regression assertions; the first-deploy runbook order still makes the required live frontend health check precede the Caddy volume integration it depends on.
